subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) Our success in life (i) by working hard (b) Ability, determination (ii) by working continuously and hard work (c) We can perform any (iii) depends on some good difficult work qualities in us. (d) Determination (iv) can hardly bring success without hard work in life. (e) To execute any (v) are some of these good scheme of life qualities. (vi) we need money. (vii) we need education.
